title: Role capability map — each seeded role gets correct access
objective: Verify the six seeded roles can/cannot access endpoint classes per the role capability map (design §9.3).
preconditions: Sessions for admin, manager, deptmgr, operator, employee, auditor.
test_data: matrix: GET /assets (all), POST /assets (operator+ allowed; employee/auditor denied), PATCH /assets/:uuid (operator+ allowed), reference-data GET (all), reference-data POST/PATCH (admin/manager per design), dashboard summary (all)
steps: For each role, attempt each endpoint in the matrix.
Record status codes and build the observed access matrix.
Compare to the design capability map.
expected_result: Observed matrix matches design: employee and auditor receive 403 PERMISSION_DENIED on asset create/update; auditor cannot mutate anything; admin unrestricted; denied responses use error envelope and leak no data.

title: Department scope filtering on asset list
objective: Verify a department-scoped user (deptmgr) sees only assets within their scope in list endpoints.
preconditions: deptmgr user scoped to department A; seed assets exist in departments A and B.
test_data: deptmgr session; asset tags known to belong to dept A and dept B
steps: GET /api/v1/assets as deptmgr; collect all returned asset departments.
GET /api/v1/assets as admin; confirm assets from dept B exist in the system.
Compare counts and department sets.
expected_result: deptmgr list contains only department-A assets; dept-B assets never appear; pagination count reflects scoped total, not global total.

title: Horizontal escalation — direct detail access to out-of-scope asset
objective: Verify a scoped user cannot read an out-of-scope asset by guessing its UUID (404, not 403, to avoid existence leak).
preconditions: UUID of a department-B asset (obtained as admin); deptmgr session scoped to dept A.
steps: As deptmgr, GET /api/v1/assets/<dept-B-uuid>.
Attempt PATCH on the same UUID.
Attempt GET /api/v1/assets/<dept-B-uuid>/history.
expected_result: All return 404 NOT_FOUND (per §11.2 existence-leak avoidance) with error envelope; no asset data disclosed; no mutation occurs.

title: Vertical escalation — low-privilege role attempts privileged mutations
objective: Verify employee/auditor sessions cannot create/modify assets or reference data even by direct API calls bypassing the UI.
preconditions: employee and auditor sessions; valid asset-create payload (captured from operator flow).
test_data: valid POST /assets payload; valid PATCH payload; reference-data POST payload
steps: As employee: POST /api/v1/assets; PATCH an in-scope visible asset if any; POST /api/v1/reference-data/categories.
As auditor: repeat the same attempts.
Verify no records were created/changed (query as admin).
expected_result: All attempts return 403 PERMISSION_DENIED; database unchanged; audit of denied attempt optional but no mutation audit events generated.

title: Field-level restriction — financial fields hidden from unauthorized roles
objective: Verify purchase_price/purchase_currency and other finance fields are serialized only for roles with finance.view.
preconditions: Seed asset with purchase price set; sessions for a finance-authorized role (per seed config, e.g. admin/manager) and a non-authorized role (employee/auditor/operator per capability map).
steps: GET /api/v1/assets/<uuid> as finance-authorized role; record financial fields.
GET same asset as non-authorized role; record fields present.
GET /api/v1/assets list as non-authorized role; check list serialization too.
expected_result: Authorized role sees money object {amount, currency}; non-authorized roles receive no financial fields (absent or null per contract) in both detail and list responses.

title: UI hides unauthorized actions but backend remains boundary
objective: Verify /auth/me capability flags drive UI (employee sees no Create Asset button) and that the backend still denies forged requests.
preconditions: UI running; employee and operator accounts.
steps: Sign in as employee; inspect nav/top bar and /assets page for create/edit affordances.
Attempt direct navigation to /assets/new as employee.
Sign in as operator; verify create/edit affordances visible.
expected_result: Employee UI hides Create/Edit actions; direct /assets/new navigation as employee yields 403 page or redirect with no data entry possible; operator sees the actions. (Backend denial verified separately in TC-FR-002-04.)

title: Scope enforcement on search and dashboard endpoints
objective: Verify /search/assets and /dashboard/summary results are scope-filtered (no cross-scope totals that mislead).
preconditions: deptmgr scoped to dept A; known dept-B assets with distinctive names.
test_data: search term matching a dept-B asset name
steps: As deptmgr, GET /api/v1/search/assets?q=<dept-B asset name>.
As deptmgr, GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary; note total asset count.
As admin, GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary; compare totals.
expected_result: Search returns no dept-B assets for deptmgr; deptmgr dashboard totals are lower than admin's and reflect only permitted records; totals reconcile with deptmgr's filtered asset list count.
